[WIP] Mesh Editing with Coding Agents

Vikas ThamizharasanSeptember 1, 2026

introduction

Given a 3D mesh, GPT6 Astra approximates parts of the shape using analytic primitives, parametric curves and surfaces, and procedural functions. It accounts for user desired edits when generating these editable, structured shape representations.

  • Click on "edit tail" → "geometry/ pose" to see shape editing and pose authoring on the fitted tail primitives, along with the exposed parameters.
  • Click on "edit mandible" to see shape editing on the fitted mandible primitives, along with the exposed parameters.
  • T-Rex mesh source.
